tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search PCBBrew's catalogue of microcontroller boards (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi Pico, display boards) and plug-in modules (sensors, displays, motor drivers, radio, storage) by name, chip, use or interface. Every entry can be placed on a PCB designed by PCBBrew; most are simulated.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: One board or module from the catalogue by id: description, pins with their role, interfaces, I2C addresses, Arduino libraries, whether PCBBrew simulates it (and on which boards), where to buy it, a picture and design_notes: practical notes from the catalogue (common clones and pitfalls, wiring, volt

tools.name: search_kicad_parts
tools.description: Search the KiCad symbol libraries PCBBrew designs with (resistors, regulators, op-amps, timers, MOSFETs, connectors...): symbol id, description and datasheet link.

tools.name: list_showcase
tools.description: Boards that PCBBrew users designed and chose to publish: title, cover image, author and likes.
